requirements_summary: High priority: in-console cost/usage breakdown by API route + model (including model family/version/alias bucketing) and CSV exports usable by finance. Needs clear cost drivers: tokens in/out, cache hit rate, retries, fallbacks, context length distribution, streaming overhead, and latency-correlated spend. Must support filters by time range, workspace/project, environment (prod/stage), deployment mode (hosted/dedicated/private), region. Strong emphasis on: (1) totals matching invoice/billing hooks, (2) RBAC gating (who can see cost + who can export), (3) audit logging for export/download events. They explicitly called out a 'What changed?' view for weekly deltas (token out up, cache hit down, model mix shift).
workload_notes: Current workload is customer support copilot (chat completions) + summarization batch jobs. Expect spiky traffic during business hours. Latency sensitivity: wants predictable p95 for interactive chat; willing to trade off cost for reliability on key endpoints. Wants ability to separate cost for streaming endpoints vs non-streaming. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations but does not want automated changes in early phase.
model_preferences: Currently evaluating llama-family models (70B-class) for quality; may need routing/fallback to smaller variants during capacity constraints. Wants reports that remain stable even if underlying model alias changes (family/version bucketing).
deployment_and_data_notes: Stated preference: VPC/private deployment for production due to customer data handling. For evaluation they can run Hosted API with redaction + retention constraints if audit logs and data residency options are clear. Asked whether exports can be restricted by workspace setting (e.g., disable exports entirely for restricted projects).
pricing_and_packaging_notes: Evaluation is anchored on ability to do internal chargeback and ongoing FinOps tracking. They view Usage Insights as a gating feature for scale. Mentioned they could consider Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput if reporting is strong. ARR estimate assumes Dedicated or Private + support.
